executivePulse.interpretation: The situation in memory and AI infrastructure remains strained. Server DRAM/RDIMM, HBM and enterprise SSDs are currently among the tightest areas. The Daily Check of 2026-08-25 reviewed eight relevant current reports; it does not indicate any confirmed material directional change. New capacity and improved yields can alleviate pressure but will reach the market only with a time lag. For buyers, supply security, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
